remarks: Welcome to 33 Douglas Ave, nestled in the charming Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford, CT. This beautifully renovated home offers the perfect blend of modern convenience and classic charm. Featuring four spacious bedrooms and two full baths, this residence is ideal for families or those seeking extra space. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry on the upper floor, making laundry day a breeze. Step outside to your private back deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. With ample parking available, you'll never have to worry about finding a spot. Location is key, and this home is just a short distance from the train station, providing easy access for commuters. Additionally, you'll find a variety of amenities nearby, ensuring you have everything you need within reach. Don't miss the opportunity to make this stunning home your own. Experience the best of Glenbrook living at 33 Douglas Ave!
